Name: STardew Overview
Author: Sto13
Description:
STardew Overview allow you to take screenshots of any location in the game regularly in order to create a timelapse of this location

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Install the GMCM mod (you get the link when downloading this mod
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Press K In Game to open the UI and configure your settings.
The screenshots are saved in the screenshot directory of the game.
Then you can use a video editor to create your timelaps (I use ImageJ to make an avi file from the screenshots separated in a few hundreds files. then I use the vindows video editor to finalize the movie)

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux(?)/macOS(?)/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode(?)
[/list]
More Timlapse videos at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj-39zAyaLsB0za9UeDY9zA
